description: The Proxmox schema marks these path parameters optional, but the API server needs the path segment. PVE::RESTHandler::find_handler splits the path with `grep { length($_) > 0 } split('\/+', $path)` ("skip empty fragments"), so an empty segment is dropped and the request routes to the parent path: DELETE /cluster/firewall/groups/g/ is routed as DELETE /cluster/firewall/groups/g. Mark every path label of this model required. Source: https://git.proxmox.com/?p=pve-common.git;a=blob;f=src/PVE/RESTHandler.pm (find_handler).
